session.venue: Addis Ababa City Rent Control Bureau - legal validation room (platform rehearsal session)
session.chair: Bureau legal lead (role of Dawit Kebede, Bureau Head, staff register STF-0005)

attendees.designation: Owner (signs the gate decision; not a session attendee)

session.method: Article-by-article walkthrough of the 47-row legal compliance test matrix. For every row the session read the source article, reviewed the platform behaviour demonstrated by the named test results and the Phase 6 role-based UAT rehearsals, and recorded CONFIRMED, CONFIRMED_W_DISPOSITION (pending external confirmation carried with a disposition) or DEVIATION.
session.scope: Proclamation No. 1320/2016 (Arts. 2-32), Addis Ababa Directive No. 7/2016 (Arts. 4-22), the annexed model rental agreement clauses, SRS v1.1 NFR-04/06/07/12 and change request CR-01 (trilingual delivery).

walkthrough.rule: Residential property status classified as new construction, previously-rented vacant, or occupied; drives the exemption clock.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed against the source article; named test case(s) pass.

walkthrough.rule: Houses administered by federal/city organs are outside this proclamation's rent-ceiling regime; scope recorded in city configuration.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed against the source article; named test case(s) pass.

walkthrough.rule: Rental of residential houses requires a written, certified and registered contract; unregistered contracts have no legal effect; payments attach only to registered files.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-01, UAT-02, UAT-06) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: The Bureau publishes the model rental agreement; the studio amends it under version control without touching superseded versions.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-01) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: Minimum lease term of two years; shorter terms are refused at intake.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-02) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: Legacy (pre-proclamation) contracts are registered during the 30+3 day campaign with a legacy annotation distinguishing migrated records.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed against the source article; named test case(s) pass.

walkthrough.rule: Annual rent adjustment studied, published June 1, effective June 30; increases beyond the ceiling refused.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-03) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: First-time pricing of new (never-rented) houses is free; the adjustment engine skips houses inside the exemption window.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed against the source article; named test case(s) pass.

walkthrough.rule: Exemption clocks: 48 months for new construction, 24 months for previously-rented vacant houses; vacancy surcharge bands 5-25 percent by vacancy years.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed against the source article; named test case(s) pass.

walkthrough.rule: Advance payment capped at two months' rent.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-02, UAT-06) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: Rent is payable only through bank or legal electronic channels; cash payments auto-open the 10 percent referral case; electronic transfers settle at the gateway before any ledger entry.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-06) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: In any proceeding the registered contract and electronic payment records are the admissible evidence; the ledger therefore refuses entries outside registered contracts.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-06) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: Termination regime including no-notice grounds; termination without statutory notice is a sanctionable offense (3 months' rent).
walkthrough.note: Confirmed against the source article; named test case(s) pass.

walkthrough.rule: National statistics and ceiling rates are published for the public; publication is a Ministry-role capability.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-08) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: The regulatory body establishes the IT system that registers contracts, records payments and produces statistics; this platform is that system and boots from the seeded hierarchy.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed against the source article; named test case(s) pass.

walkthrough.rule: Tenant complaints (overcharge, illegal eviction, etc.) are received through multiple channels and registered against the eight statutory grounds.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-04) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: The complaint decision is due within 30 working days of receipt; the decision clock opens at intake and closes at decision.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-04) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: Appeals to the hearing committee must be filed within 15 days of the decision; late appeals are refused.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-05) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: The committee hears appeals within the hearing window and may escalate to the courts; window encoded as a confirmed parameter (O-9 verified 30 days).
walkthrough.note: Confirmed; O-9 closed: committee window = 30 days, basis cited in parameter seed

walkthrough.rule: Administrative fines are capped at three months' rent of the affected contract; the cap applies at computation time.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-07) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: Regional implementation is by directive; per-city parameter sets exist so Addis Ababa values never hard-code.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed against the source article; named test case(s) pass.

walkthrough.rule: Contract content follows the annexed model; the seeded model carries the required section structure in trilingual renderings.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-01, UAT-08) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: Registration requires the identification documents (five accepted types), ownership evidence and proxy documents with two witnesses.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed against the source article; named test case(s) pass.

walkthrough.rule: Registration happens in person at the woreda where the house is located; files are opened on a woreda-tier org unit with a computer-typed form.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-01, UAT-02) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: The nine-point document verification checklist must be completed before certification.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-01, UAT-02) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: Registrar certification acts follow checklist completion; the registry records who certified.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-01) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: Stamping desk applies the office round stamp; database entry and the uniform registry book follow with sequential numbering (50 entries per page).
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-01) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: Amendments must be registered within the 30-day window; rate-affected amendments checked against the incoming rate set.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed against the source article; named test case(s) pass.

walkthrough.rule: Annual increase study feeds publication June 1 and effect June 30; the calendar engine enumerates the statutory events.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-03) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: Registration corrections are recorded as annotations on the file, never as silent rewrites of certified data.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed against the source article; named test case(s) pass.

walkthrough.rule: Hard and soft records, document scanning, upward tier replication (hop counts by tier) and per-tier nightly backups.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed against the source article; named test case(s) pass.

walkthrough.rule: Bureau, sub-city and woreda duties map to the role catalogue with tier scopes; data aggregates upward through the hierarchy.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed against the source article; named test case(s) pass.

walkthrough.rule: Exactly eight complaint grounds are configured, matching the directive's list.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-04) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: Complaints arrive via walk-in, phone, web, letter and third-party referral; verbal statements require a minimum factual description.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-04) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: Admissibility verification, investigation, decision and notice proceed in statutory order with deadline escalation.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-04) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: Control teams act on sub-city authority, show identification credentials on visit, and monitor vacancy.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-07) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: Prohibited acts (demanding excess advance, unregistered renting, unauthorized increase, noticeless termination, illegal eviction) map one-to-one to offense parameters.
walkthrough.note: O1 tracked: offense-level figures configurable as PENDING_OFFICIAL_TEXT pending official Amharic text

walkthrough.rule: Penalty ladder: cash-payment 10 percent referral rule, vacancy surcharge bands 5/10/15/20/25 percent, tax escalation and court referral; cap enforced.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-07) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: Lessor, lessee and property blocks are populated from registered party and property profiles; they cannot diverge from the registry.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-01) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: House status selector drives the exemption clock; rent in words and figures; term at least two years; service-charge payer enum.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-01) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: Advance and monthly due day captured; advance capped at two months (Proc. Art. 12).
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-06) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: The contract takes effect only upon regulator certification; execution requires three witnesses with identification.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-01) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: Access control between tiers: woreda, sub-city, Bureau, committee, Ministry and system roles can execute only their own capabilities; anonymous calls are refused.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed by the UAT rehearsal (UAT-02, UAT-03) and passing named test case(s).

walkthrough.rule: Every state-changing action appends an immutable audit event; the SHA-256 chain detects any alteration of history.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed against the source article; named test case(s) pass.

walkthrough.rule: Payment and identification sandboxes integrate with defined failure and timeout behaviour; identity timeouts degrade gracefully with a deferral note instead of blocking the office.
walkthrough.note: Confirmed against the source article; named test case(s) pass.

walkthrough.rule: Amharic, English and Afan Oromo interfaces from seeded localization resources; certified Afan Oromo legal glossary tracked as open item O-8 with fallback.
walkthrough.note: O-8 tracked: Afan Oromo legal glossary certification pending; fallback per NFR-06

walkthrough.rule: Sequential register numbering enforced database-side; certified contract records immutable after certification (corrections via annotations only).
walkthrough.note: Confirmed against the source article; named test case(s) pass.

legalSession.conclusion: No unresolved deviation. Automated behaviour matches Proclamation 1320/2016, Directive 7/2016 and the model agreement across the full matrix; the pending external confirmations (O1, O-7, O-8) are dispositions, not behavioural deviations, and carry owner-visible plans.

memorandum.to: Project Owner, Residential House Rent Control and Administration System
memorandum.from: Bureau Legal Validation Session (chair: Bureau legal lead)
memorandum.subject: Legal validation of the Rent Control and Administration Platform - Gate G6 memorandum
body: We have validated the platform's automated behaviour against Proclamation No. 1320/2016, Addis Ababa Directive No. 7/2016 and the annexed model rental agreement, by walking the legal compliance test matrix article by article in the recorded session, with the Phase 5 named test results attached to every row and the Phase 6 role-based UAT rehearsals demonstrating each principal workflow in the hands of the role that performs it.

The registration chain (written contract on the Bureau model, nine-point verification, certification, separate stamping desk, sequential registry book and upward replication) behaves as the directive prescribes, including its refusals: short leases, excess advance, wrong-office filing, checklist short-cuts and cross-role acts are all refused with the violated article named. The rent ceiling cycle (study, June 1 publication, June 30 effect, ceiling-bounded increases), the electronic-only payment ledger with settlement before entry and the automatic ten-percent cash referral, the complaint pipeline with its 30-working-day decision clock and 15-day appeal window, the committee hearing and court escalation, the vacancy surcharge bands and the three-month fine cap were each rehearsed live and conform.

Three confirmations remain pending outside the platform and are recorded as dispositions, not deviations: the Directive Article 22 fine-ladder figures await the official Amharic text (O1, parameters configurable, no code change needed); the woreda register counts for some sub-cities remain provisional pending the official register reconciliation before the pilot (O-7); and the certified Afan Oromo legal glossary workshop with the Bureau is scheduled before the Phase 7 pilot (O-8), with the NFR-06 fallback active meanwhile. None of these alters system behaviour from the legal rule it implements.

No unresolved deviation. Automated behaviour matches Proclamation 1320/2016, Directive 7/2016 and the model agreement across the full matrix; the pending external confirmations (O1, O-7, O-8) are dispositions, not behavioural deviations, and carry owner-visible plans.

severityDefs.name: Critical
severityDefs.definition: A legal gate is not enforced, data is lost or corrupted, or a core workflow is blocked for all users. The system cannot lawfully operate until fixed.
severityDefs.fixSchedule: Immediate; fix before any further acceptance activity.
severityDefs.reTest: Full battery re-run plus the named compliance case.

severityDefs.name: Major
severityDefs.definition: A principal workflow is blocked or produces a legally wrong outcome for a class of cases, with no acceptable workaround.
severityDefs.fixSchedule: Within the phase; blocks the gate while open.
severityDefs.reTest: Failed scenario re-run end to end.

severityDefs.name: Minor
severityDefs.definition: A defect with a legal or operational workaround, or limited to a secondary surface (e.g. a read-path control with all mutating paths guarded).
severityDefs.fixSchedule: Scheduled with an explicit due phase; does not block the gate while the disposition is agreed.
severityDefs.reTest: Targeted re-test at the scheduled phase.

severityDefs.name: Observation
severityDefs.definition: Working as designed but flagged for improvement, or pending an external confirmation that does not change behaviour.
severityDefs.reTest: Verified at the next touching phase.
